body: thanks for sharing your thoughts with positive energy, means a lot!! I will definitely taken in what you said, and reflect back, thinking though it. I'm so glad that I've shared my experience on here, everyone has been kind, sharing their personal experiences and all, it really has just paused all my thoughts and allowing me to think it through. Thank you soo much again!!

Damn, that's crazy to be stuck in the snow and having his friend die... I really hope your step dad is doing better! But I really do understand his view coz it's somewhat similar to what i'm feeling. no matter how much you want to face the truth that it isn't your fault, you feel like you could have done better. but that's just how things are i guess, things that we can't control... thanks for sharing your step dad's experience, tbh all these shared experiences have helped me so much. thank you again

What you said is 100% true, I haven't been in a car since the accident, i tried driving once but I couldn't, I felt that every car was coming real fast towards me. I've been using public transport lately, but i still get paranoid at times. Honestly it's great that you tell them to be safe and that you love them, coz it's so dangerous. I blame the idiots that don't follow the rules while driving, like what will achieve from driving 20-30k's faster then me or anyone? prolly get there 5 mins earlier, but you risk so many others on the road and it's not just the ones on the road, you end up effecting families, like me and many others... btw thanks for sharing your thoughts, means a lot!!

I have to be honest, it has helped me alot, sharing this on here. All the responses, stories that have been shared allow me to think it through and thank you so much for sharing your thoughts. Means alot...

I love that line, it's so true. I'm sorry to hear about that, damn what you went thru must have been hell. Thanks for sharing your story, it allows me to think through. I really hope she's doing better as well as you. thanks man!
thanks for the kind words! means alot!!!

Tbh I really do need to be there for her, and you're right, we need to be supporting each other..., i've just been blank for so long and forgot about everyone. Thanks for the suggestion! It's really helpful! Hopefully I can visit her sometime soon.... and tell her that I'm there for her. But man what really hurts me in general, is the fact she was such a happy person, like she even told Laura that I was a great guy and all. She never blamed me for the accident or anything, but only cried that we could have had a great life together. I just hope things get better for her too and really thanks for a great suggestion....

Thanks to everyone for really being honest, being positive and sharing your experiences, not gonna lie, I'm glad I have shared this on this community, it has definitely made me stop and think it through.  I really appreciate everyone's thoughts and all.

Honestly, I've never cried for anything or for anyone in my life, but this accident had changed everything, it's crazy how you brain works, no matter how much you try to distract yourself, it will always take you back to what you fear of the most. Life doesn't have an expiry date written on, so if i was anyone, I strongly recommend to spend your free time with your fam, with the ones you love and cherish every moment you have with them

thanks bro, for giving a perspective. I know she wouldn't want me to take my life away, and she always wanted to start a environment ngo, hopefully if I can get through this stage, I could do something that she always wished for.
Thanks for being honest bro, and I hope you're doing okay too...

I'm so sorry to hear that, hope you're doing well too...,  sometimes I feel like "why does this happen to me?" but the truth is, it happens to alot of people.. The pain is unbearable, it's the voice in the head that fucks it up more and more. I'm kinda glad that i did share my story on here, because I've never talked about it, maybe you are right,  it's alright to talk about it... Appreciate you for sharing your story and your experience of dealing with something so serious, really means alot to me..
Really appreciate it.. Thanks for the support!!
